job.question: In the Police Retirement System of St. Louis (PRS-STL) actuarial RFP, how many years of experience must the principal actuary have?
job.expected_facts: A minimum of five years of professional actuarial experience, plus a minimum of five years of experience testifying before legislative and administrative bodies.
job.acceptance: Five years professional actuarial experience is the core number. A complete description may state the separate five-year testimony requirement; these are not additive ten years and may overlap. Credentials are optional for this question.

reviews.reason: This is a City of Hartford RFP for a general investment consultant, not the PRS-STL actuarial RFP. Its five-year requirement applies to a primary investment consultant and does not establish the principal actuary’s qualifications.
quotes: REQUEST FOR PROPOSALS (“RFP”) GENERAL INVESTMENT CONSULTANT
The primary consultant assigned to the MERF and OPEB relationship shall have a minimum of five (5) years of consulting experience with defined benefit public pension plans
